home.title: Servers
home.emptyHint: Add the address of an Openlive server, scan its QR code, or open an invite on this phone.

add.title: Add a server
add.prompt: What is the address of your Openlive server?
add.invalidUrl: That is not an address. Try something like openlive.example.com.
add.alreadyAdded: This server is already on the list.

compat.too_old: This server runs an older version of Openlive than this app supports. Ask whoever runs it to update.
compat.too_new: This server needs a newer version of the app. Update Openlive.
compat.no_app_login: This server does not allow signing in from the app yet. Ask whoever runs it to update.

scan.title: Scan a QR code
scan.hint: Point the camera at the QR code of a server or of an invite.
scan.permission: Openlive needs the camera to read the QR code.
scan.unknown: This QR code is not an Openlive address or invite.

instance.noSpaces: You are not in any space on this server yet.
instance.signedOutHint: Sign in to see your spaces on this server.
instance.expired: Your session on this server ended. Sign in again.
instance.remove: Remove this server from the phone
instance.noSpacesHint: Open an invite link on this phone to join one.

invite.title: Invite to {{space}}
invite.pending: Your request was sent. A manager of the space will review it.
invite.signInFirst: Sign in to accept the invite.

login.cancelled: The sign-in was closed before it finished.
login.denied: You did not allow the app on this server.
login.state_mismatch: The sign-in answer did not match this request. Try again.
login.invalid: The sign-in answer was not valid. Try again.

errors.network: Could not reach the server. Check the address and your connection.
errors.invalid_instance: This address does not answer as an Openlive server.
errors.app_code_invalid: The sign-in code expired or was already used. Try again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.unauthenticated: Your session on this server ended. Sign in again.

space.noRoomsHint: Rooms of this space show up here when someone creates one.
space.reconnecting: Connection lost. Who is here may be out of date until it is back.
space.presenceEnded: Live updates of this space stopped. Pull down to try again.

room.replaced: This room was opened in another place with your account.

chat.off: The chat is off in this room.

player.title: Watch
player.soonHint: Watching streams in the app is the next step.

voice.title: Voice
voice.startFailed: The phone could not start the call. Try again.
voice.unsupported: This build cannot keep a call alive in the background (Android only).
voice.micBlocked: The microphone is blocked for Openlive. You are in voice, listening only. Turn it on in the app's settings to talk.

micError.denied: The microphone was not allowed. You are in voice, listening only.
micError.no_device: No microphone found. You are in voice, listening only.
micError.device_lost: The microphone was taken away (a call, or it was unplugged). You are listening only.
micError.unsupported: This phone cannot use the microphone here.
micError.failed: The microphone could not start. You are in voice, listening only.

mode.title: Microphone
mode.hint: Push to talk keeps the microphone closed until you hold the big button.

route.autoHint: Headset when there is one, else the speaker
route.speaker: Speaker

voice.networkWeak: Weak connection: voice comes first, cameras are paused.

join.entry: Join a room with a code
join.hint: A quick room's code (like OL-4821-0937) or its link, or an invite link or token.
join.unknown: That is not a room code or an invite link.
join.unknownCode: That is not a room code.
join.otherServer: That link is for {{host}}. Open it from that server.
join.noServer: Sign in to a server first to join a room.

permission.title: Microphone
permission.message: Openlive needs the microphone so the others in the room can hear you. Sound only goes to the room you join, and only while you are in it.
permission.blockedMessage: The microphone is blocked for Openlive. Turn it on in the app's settings to talk in a room.

debug.title: Voice test
debug.unsupported: This build has no native voice support (Android only).

settings.title: Settings
settings.name: Name

photo.tooBig: That picture is too large (5 MB at most).
photo.denied: Allow the camera in the phone's settings to take a photo.

settings.pushToTalkHint: Hold the button to speak, in new calls.

settings.description: Short sounds in the app, each with a message on screen. They play while the app is open.
